dedupe_keys.name: osier multi objective energy system optimizer

description: Osier is a Python framework for multi-objective optimization of energy systems. Its public repository provides examples and documentation for defining technology choices, demand and objectives, then inspecting trade-offs, not selecting a single weighted result. The spatial coverage is a user-defined power or energy system, and the temporal coverage follows the input demand and planning horizon; Osier is not a fixed regional dataset. The own repository reports a BSD three-clause licence. A modeller could use it to compare electricity supply portfolios and the effect of adding nuclear or renewable capacity under competing cost and other objectives. The result is conditional on technologies, constraints and objective functions chosen by the user. It cannot by itself show whether any portfolio is permitted or physically deliverable.
